$description: Flags the owner approved for the quality gate (OD-298). open-ds compare reads this file from the candidate. An approval clears one flag. Each entry names: scheme; theme (the mode, light or dark, a brand theme such as aster-dark, or * for every theme); check (the criterion id that raised the flag, such as relations.ladder-order, relations.state-sign, relations.shared-split or invariants.spacing-map); token, or pair (two token names; a component pair names its foreground and background CSS variables, such as --menubar-item-label-destructive and --menubar-content-background, or color.surface.canvas for the page); why; approved_by. An entry with a token and no check approves a color move (the shift criteria). A file with an invalid entry stops the run. Only the owner adds entries.
